verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ יוֹנָ֖ה שֵׁנִ֥ית לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yō·w·nāh šê·nîṯ lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Jonah a second time . . .
verses.literalPt: E VEIO a palavra do SENHOR segunda vez a Jonas, dizendo:

verses.original: ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ אֶל־ נִֽינְוֵ֖ה הָעִ֣יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וִּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֶת־ הַקְּרִיאָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qūm lêḵ ’el- nî·nə·wêh hā·‘îr hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh wiq·rå̄ ’ê·le·hā ’eṯ- haq·qə·rî·’āh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî dō·ḇêr ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Get up Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message that I give you
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, e vai à grande cidade de Nínive, e prega contra ela a mensagem que eu te digo.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם יוֹנָ֗ה וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ נִֽינְוֶ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וְנִֽינְוֵ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה עִיר־ גְּדוֹלָה֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים מַהֲלַ֖ךְ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām yō·w·nāh way·yê·leḵ ’el- nī·nə·wɛh kiḏ·ḇar Yah·weh wə·nî·nə·wêh hā·yə·ṯāh ‘îr- gə·ḏō·w·lāh lê·lō·hîm ma·hă·laḵ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: This time Jonah got up and went to Nineveh in accordance with the word of the LORD Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city requiring a three-day . . . journey
verses.literalPt: E levantou-se Jonas, e foi a Nínive, segundo a palavra do SENHOR. Ora, Nínive era uma cidade muito grande, de três dias de caminho.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤חֶל יוֹנָה֙ לָב֣וֹא בָעִ֔יר מַהֲלַ֖ךְ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֑ד וַיִּקְרָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר ע֚וֹד אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְנִֽינְוֵ֖ה נֶהְפָּֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḥel yō·w·nāh lā·ḇō·w ḇā·‘îr ma·hă·laḵ yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ way·yiq·rā way·yō·mar ‘ō·wḏ ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm wə·nî·nə·wêh neh·pā·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: On the first day of his journey Jonah . . . set out into the city and proclaimed . . . Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned
verses.literalPt: E começou Jonas a entrar pela cidade caminho de um dia, e pregava, dizendo: Ainda quarenta dias, e Nínive será subvertida.

verses.original: וַֽיַּאֲמִ֛ינוּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י נִֽינְוֵ֖ה בֵּֽאלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקְרְאוּ־ צוֹם֙ וַיִּלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים מִגְּדוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־ קְטַנָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·’ă·mî·nū ’an·šê nî·nə·wêh bê·lō·hîm way·yiq·rə·’ū- ṣō·wm way·yil·bə·šū śaq·qîm mig·gə·ḏō·w·lām wə·‘aḏ- qə·ṭan·nām
verses.literal: And the Ninevites believed God They proclaimed a fast and dressed in sackcloth from the greatest of them to the least
verses.literalPt: E os homens de Nínive creram em Deus; e proclamaram um jejum, e vestiram-se de saco, desde o maior até ao menor.

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֤ע הַדָּבָר֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶך נִֽינְוֵ֔ה וַיָּ֙קָם֙ מִכִּסְא֔וֹ וַיַּעֲבֵ֥ר אַדַּרְתּ֖וֹ מֵֽעָלָ֑יו וַיְכַ֣ס שַׂ֔ק וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל־ הָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·ga‘ had·dā·ḇār ’el- mɛ·lɛḵ nî·nə·wêh way·yā·qām mik·kis·’ōw way·ya·‘ă·ḇêr ’ad·dar·tōw mê·‘ā·lāw way·ḵas śaq way·yê·šeḇ ‘al- hā·’ê·p̄er
verses.literal: When word . . . reached the king of Nineveh he got up from his throne took off his royal robe covered himself with sackcloth and sat . . . in ashes
verses.literalPt: Esta palavra chegou também ao rei de Nínive; e ele levantou-se do seu trono, e tirou de si as suas vestes, e cobriu-se de saco, e sentou-se sobre a cinza.

verses.original: וַיַּזְעֵ֗ק וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ בְּנִֽינְוֵ֔ה מִטַּ֧עַם הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וּגְדֹלָ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר הָאָדָ֨ם וְהַבְּהֵמָ֜ה הַבָּקָ֣ר וְהַצֹּ֗אן אַֽל־ יִטְעֲמוּ֙ מְא֔וּמָה אַ֨ל־ יִרְע֔וּ וּמַ֖יִם אַל־ יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaz·‘êq way·yō·mer bə·nî·nə·wêh miṭ·ṭa·‘am ham·me·leḵ ū·ḡə·ḏō·lāw lê·mōr hā·’ā·ḏām wə·hab·bə·hê·māh hab·bā·qār wə·haṣ·ṣōn ’al- yiṭ·‘ă·mū mə·’ū·māh ’al- yir·‘ū ū·ma·yim ’al- yiš·tū
verses.literal: Then he issued a proclamation . . . in Nineveh By the decree of the king and his nobles . . . Let no man or beast herd or flock taste anything at all They must not eat or drink . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E fez uma proclamação que se divulgou em Nínive, pelo decreto do rei e dos seus grandes, dizendo: Nem homens, nem animais, nem bois, nem ovelhas provem coisa alguma, nem se lhes dê alimentos, nem bebam água;

verses.original: וְיִתְכַּסּ֣וּ שַׂקִּ֗ים הָֽאָדָם֙ וְהַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְיִקְרְא֥וּ אֶל־ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּחָזְקָ֑ה וְיָשֻׁ֗בוּ אִ֚ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָֽרָעָ֔ה וּמִן־ הֶחָמָ֖ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּכַפֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiṯ·kas·sū śaq·qîm hā·’ā·ḏām wə·hab·bə·hê·māh wə·yiq·rə·’ū ’el- ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·ḥā·zə·qāh wə·yā·šu·ḇū ’îš mid·dar·kōw hā·rā·‘āh ū·min- he·ḥā·mās ’ă·šer bə·ḵap·pê·hem
verses.literal: Furthermore, let both man and beast be covered with sackcloth and have everyone call out earnestly to God Let each one turn from his evil ways and from the violence in his hands
verses.literalPt: Mas os homens e os animais sejam cobertos de sacos, e clamem fortemente a Deus, e convertam-se, cada um do seu mau caminho, e da violência que há nas suas mãos.

verses.original: מִֽי־ יוֹדֵ֣עַ יָשׁ֔וּב וְנִחַ֖ם הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְשָׁ֛ב מֵחֲר֥וֹן אַפּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֹאבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: mî- yō·w·ḏê·a‘ yā·šūḇ wə·ni·ḥam hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·šāḇ mê·ḥă·rō·wn ’ap·pōw wə·lō nō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: Who knows God may turn and relent He may turn from His fierce anger so that we will not perish
verses.literalPt: Quem sabe se se voltará Deus, e se arrependerá, e se apartará do furor da sua ira, de sorte que não pereçamos?

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶֽת־ מַ֣עֲשֵׂיהֶ֔ם כִּי־ שָׁ֖בוּ מִדַּרְכָּ֣ם הָרָעָ֑ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים עַל־ הָרָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר לַעֲשׂוֹת־ לָהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ma·‘ă·śê·hem kî- šā·ḇū mid·dar·kām hā·rā·‘āh way·yin·nā·ḥem hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘al- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer- dib·ber la·‘ă·śō·wṯ- lā·hem wə·lō ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: When God saw their actions that they had turned from their evil ways He relented from the disaster He had threatened to bring upon them
verses.literalPt: E Deus viu as obras deles, como se converteram do seu mau caminho; e Deus se arrependeu do mal que tinha anunciado lhes faria, e não o fez.
